full_judgment: 25. Mere statement of the respondent that the whereabouts of the original lessee or his legal heirs were not known from 28-2-1972 to 1978 will not absolve the respondent from his responsibility of showing that a proceeding was taken in respect of the property in question sometime after 28-2-1972 and pursuant to the proceeding possession of the same has been taken over on a certain date treating the property as abandoned property. Presumption attached to section 5(2) of the Abandoned Buildings (Supplementary Provisions) Ordinance, 1985 is rebuttable and Annexures to a writ petition together with the facts and circumstances of the case can rebut the presumption. The statement that somebody else was found in the house will also not absolve the respondent from serving notice upon the occupant of the house.
